origin: Codex-assisted source-based diagnostic selection; not human approval or an unbiased accuracy sample
selection_method: Inspected permitted original Slack messages/replies/reactions for control characteristics, without reading hidden evaluation labels or existing Agent 2 outputs for controls. Four candidate groups inspected from sources; selected one explicit scoped tie answer with TL endorsement and a different group with procedure before a category decision.
common_review_criteria: Every member and original message remains represented with exact evidence and lineage.
Complete requested information/decision must be settled for ANSWERED; indirect but unambiguous answers can suffice. PARTIAL needs a real substantive answered component, not helpful procedure alone.
Retain scoped/conditional TL guidance and actual reaction users/targets; no cross-thread transfer of resolution.

Assess operational severity independently of task labels, flags and unanswered questions. Do not invent delay, rework or quality/safety consequence. Preserve HIGH where explicit blockage is supported.
Retain all inherited obligations and announcements; no invented questions or automatic conservative relabeling.

cases.source_review: M01/M04 silence and M02/M03 playback handling remain unsettled by diagnostics. M05 E014 asks should I Quarantine; E015 gives reporting/do-not-score guidance and non-evaluability, but does not decide Quarantine eligibility. M06 E016 asks QN or a player issue; E019 more directly answers playback handling, so assess individually and preserve this legitimate substantive guidance without treating it as general Quarantine policy. Do not require an exact OPEN/PARTIAL label where reasonable scope disagreement remains.
cases.guidance_and_severity: Keep E007 reproduction-before-workaround and conditional both-task-ID instruction, E010 waveform check, E003 intended-silence/file-elsewhere checks. E015/E019 explicitly establish inability to evaluate affected tasks, supporting HIGH for playback scope. Silence impact may be UNKNOWN. No attempted/failed historical workaround is established. E005 thumbsup is by a tutor, not TL.

cases.source_review: M02 explicitly asks tie or preference for the local pair; E005 tells the member to choose a tie for this example and is endorsed by TL U001 using agree. The scoped choice is a complete answer to that decision and must not be reopened merely because other threads remain uncertain. Anyone else seeing this is a conversational prefix here, not evidence that the tie/preference decision is unanswered.
cases.other_scope: M01 asks how much improvement avoids a tie: E003 supplies cosmetic-phrasing guidance and a tie for this example but does not establish a numeric/global threshold. Preserve the exact-user-task condition; reasonable partial-versus-contextual-complete interpretation should be explained. M03 has inconsistent feedback and requests both rationales before threshold change; no threshold change decided. M04/M05 scoped tie guidance and this/white_check_mark TL endorsements remain local; do not invent questions for bare reports.
cases.severity: Task vocabulary major/minor and QA disagreement alone do not establish operational severity. No unsupported rework, blocked work or broad quality impact. Retain both inherited obligations.

cases.source_review: M02 asks which safety category applies. QA/TL ask to distinguish override language from actual harmful output before choosing a category; no actual category is selected. Preserve that unresolved decision with useful diagnostics/instructions. M03 asks automatic-unsafety and correct handling: the need to inspect actual content can substantively address the automatic-keyword assumption but does not necessarily select a category. Explain answered and unresolved components rather than forcing a predetermined status.
cases.announcement: M01 TL collects examples/task references and explicitly says no final decision yet. Preserve ANNOUNCEMENT/INSTRUCTION and its null root question, while retaining any genuine reply information question/diagnostic. No final policy or safety category may be invented.
cases.severity: Safety/jailbreak task vocabulary is not operational safety impact. No concrete operational consequence or risk mechanism established in these messages; retain insufficient-impact uncertainty and the inherited announcement obligation.

illustration_is_unrelated: Only synthetic export-reporting versus submission-eligibility example enters the system prompt; none of these case reviews or control labels enters runtime requests.
